_about: Who may call whom. keycloak/render.py turns this into token audiences and role mappings for every customer's realm. A service accepts a token only if its own client id is in the token's audience, so 'calls' is the allow-list: to let X call Y, add Y to calls[X]. A client that verifies its own sign-in tokens (scribe, knowledge-base) lists itself. user_roles: the realm roles a person's token carries in that app; agents never carry admin. admin_api: the Keycloak admin rights in tenant-service's own tokens. token_exchange: clients allowed to exchange an agent's token for one addressed to another service.
